title: Review card
description: One study card you add yourself (content/review/<deck>.json → cards[]). Only `term` is required; leave any other field out or empty. Also the shape Gemini returns when it fills a card in.

id.description: Optional stable id (letters, digits, dashes). Defaults to the term slug. Set it if you may later rename the term, so review progress is kept.

term.description: The English word, phrase, collocation or structure, e.g. 'trustworthy', 'take something for granted'.

pronunciation.description: British IPA between slashes, e.g. '/ˈtrʌstwɜːði/'. Empty if unknown.

part_of_speech.description: e.g. ['adjective'] or ['noun', 'verb']. For collocations use the pattern, e.g. ['adjective + noun'].

meaning_vi.description: Vietnamese meaning. Markdown allowed (**bold**, lists). Several senses: one per line, numbered.

examples.description: Example sentences. `vi` (translation) is optional. Plain strings are also accepted when written by hand.

en.description: English sentence; wrap the term in **bold**.

usage_note_vi.description: Vietnamese usage note: register, common mistakes, when to use. Markdown allowed.
